notes.title: Box Bakery demo is about to close!
notes.notes: [p]Thank you all for playing our game! Reading your comments, fixing bugs, and adding new content have kept us energized every single day![/p][p]The demo will be going offline on July 30th, so it’s time to say goodbye for now. During this test, we’ve added tons of new features and systems, and also fixed some very deep-rooted bugs. Since we can’t carry these foundational issues into the full release, your current demo save data won’t carry over.[/p][p]We’re working hard on even more new features, new characters, and lots and lots (and lots!) of fun content! ✨[/p][p]This goodbye is just so we can return in even better shape when the full version is ready. Thank you so much for your support and understanding.[/p][p]There might be a second demo in the future, featuring the latest version of the game — we’ll secretly post about it when the time comes, so keep an eye out![/p][p]Don’t forget to follow us, and we hope to see you again in your dreams.[/p][p]— From the dev team of Box Bakery, still busy baking in the kitchen! 🧁[/p]

notes.title: Thank you so much for playing our game! 🥐
notes.notes:
[p]We are currently working on the story content for the next town, and we expect to finish production by the end of this year (fingers crossed!).
This demo includes only 3 hours of main story content (that’s right — while you can technically keep playing, the main storyline is limited to about 3 hours, and each animal only has two collectible stamps for now).[/p][p]Thank you so much for your enthusiastic support and for playing our demo — we’ll do our very best to make the full game even better!ːsteamhappyː[/p][p]Unfortunately, this demo is a [b]progress-wipe test version[/b], and your save data won’t carry over to the full release.
But here’s the good news — the [b]official version will include many new features[/b], with deeper gameplay and expanded content. We hope you’re looking forward to it![/p][p]In the future, we plan to develop [b]six completely different towns[/b], each with [b]eight unique animal friends[/b] you can befriend — that’s [b]a total of 48 distinct animal characters[/b] to meet and explore![/p][p]We truly hope you’ll have a great time playing our game. See you in the next update — [b]love you all![/b] 💛[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45009915/92cee3c63282c1e8cf186920b40b186005af1af5.gif"][/img][/p][p]Thank you all for joining us! Our Discord channel invite code is pSAUkq4CQb — we’d love to see you there! Come hang out, share your thoughts, report bugs, and be part of our cozy little community. We can’t wait to meet you![/p]
